[the rule's own record before the fold]
kb/Work PB225 + PB823 (wave 45 A) closed the two residues on this row. (1) PB225, items g)-m): g)/m) FARTHEST-FROM-ZERO / NEAREST-TO-ZERO read AlgebraicRanges, the extremes HIGHEST-/SMALLEST-ALGEBRAIC and SET format 15 already share (Annex D.32), compared through the one relation renderer for a fixed-point item; DETERMINATION: 'whether that value is positive or negative' admits EITHER direction's extreme (it differs only for a two's-complement container, 13.18.60.4 GR12 - PIC S9(4) COMP-5 is FARTHEST-FROM-ZERO at -32768 and at 32767). h)-k) and every float question are decided by CobolFloatClass on the carrier's RAW ISO/IEC 60559 bits (the typed field, or a REDEFINES window's bits), never a widened value - a binary32->binary64 widening quiets a signaling NaN. l) compares the item's range with ArithmeticModes.IntermediateExtremes exactly; every declarable description is contained, so it reduces to 'a numeric value' (finite for a float). n) 1. b. is now implemented: NUMERIC over a STANDARD float usage is true only for a finite value (a FLOAT-BINARY-64 infinity was folded to TRUE). (2) PB823, item n): which of n) 1./n) 2. applies is decided by the OPERAND's category through THE ONE reader, so a reference-modified signed DISPLAY item (category alphanumeric, 8.4.3.3.4 GR6 c) takes n) 2.'s all-digits test and the over-punched image 123M is NOT numeric (it answered TRUE). Items a)-f) as before (PB109, PB64 T5, PB590); the ALPHABETIC classification selector is PB760's ObjectComputerEmit.ClassificationArg.

[folded GR-8.8.4.4.4-L2.1 = §8.8.4.4.4 3) n) 1.: CONFORMS]
kb/Work PB1466 LANDED - all three arms. (1) BINARY / COMP-5 / PACKED leaves a character channel reaches (group MOVE, READ, BY REFERENCE) are image-stored (wave 65 E; StorageFormPass.IsImagePromotable), so RenderClass takes the windowed arm and CobolNum.IsNumericImage answers GR3 n) 1. c. on the bytes (conformance:cases/8.8.4.4-Simple-class-condition/pb1466_numeric_class_stored_image). (2) A numeric FUNCTION operand is category numeric and is tested by n) 1. on its VALUE (conformance:cases/8.5.2.12-Numeric-category/pb1401_computed_numeric_class). (3) A USAGE NATIONAL numeric leaf is now image-promoted too (wave 1001 D, unblocked by kb/Work PB1665: an alphanumeric group's ImageWidth counts storage characters, so the group MOVE across a promoted national numeric leaf no longer truncates): MOVE N"AB1" TO a GROUP-USAGE NATIONAL group over PIC 9(3) USAGE NATIONAL answers NOT NUMERIC, MOVE SPACES to an alphanumeric group holding the leaf answers NOT NUMERIC, N"123" is numeric, and a signed SIGN TRAILING SEPARATE national leaf is numeric only for a trailing sign (conformance:cases/8.8.4.4-Simple-class-condition/pb1466_national_numeric_class_image). Earlier witnesses stand: windowed leaves via CobolNum.IsNumericImage (conformance:cases/_unassigned/pb230_class_numeric_image, conformance:cases/13.18.52-SIGN/pb803_sign_valid_set), floats via FloatTest(Finite) (conformance:cases/8.8.4.4-Simple-class-condition/pb225_float_class_conditions), DISPLAY leaves promoted to StoreAsImage.

[folded GR-8.8.4.4.4-L2.2 = §8.8.4.4.4 3) n) 2.: CONFORMS]
Rule (GR3 n)2): non-numeric category -> true iff the content consists entirely of 0-9 (cite.py --check 8.8.4.4.4 'consists entirely of the characters 0, 1, 2, 3' family -> OK). RenderClass picks n)2 by the OPERAND's category through StringCategoryOf (PB823 landed: a ref-mod slice of a numeric item is alphanumeric per §8.4.3.3.4 GR6 c)), and CobolClass.IsNumeric admits only '0'..'9', no sign, empty -> false. Probed: AX '+12' -> F, AX '012' -> T, numeric-edited ZZ9 holding '  5' -> F, alphanumeric group 'AB1' -> n)2 path. The misrouting of a numeric-category FUNCTION into this test is a defect of n)1 (GR-8.8.4.4.4-L2.1), not of this rule's predicate.
